name: Metadata list
purpose: Show the label and value pairs that describe one record.
description: Aligned labels and values keep record detail scannable next to the content it belongs to.

guidance.summary: Shows the label and value pairs that describe one record: who, what, when, and where it stands.
useWhen: A person needs to orient themselves on a record before acting: its owner, stage, and key attributes.
A consequence or a context is a handful of named facts.

avoidWhen.text: Many records with the same attributes.
Values that differ between a record and its source.

states.label: Default
states.description: Label and value pairs, labels muted and values aligned.

dos.title: The few pairs that orient
dos.description: Three to six pairs a person reads before acting.

dos.title: Labels as the record names them
dos.description: People find the same field elsewhere by its label.

donts.title: Every attribute at once
donts.description: The pair that matters drowns among the ones that do not.

donts.title: A card per pair
donts.description: Boxes around facts repeat what alignment already groups.

content: Values are short: a name, a date, a stage.

notes: A description list: each label is a term and each value its description.

composition.defaultVisible: The pairs that orient a person; the rest in a closed region.
composition.density: Compact by nature; past six pairs, move the rest to a region or detail view.

redundantWith.reason: A card per attribute repeats the list's grouping.

mistakes: Ten or more pairs open by default.
Pairs that repeat the heading above them.
composition.responsive: Labels sit above values on a narrow screen.
